_comment: Descriptors for the 4 MediCase coded agents. Maps each Maestro Case stage to the coded-agent entry-point it invokes. UiPath SDK registration metadata is filled in during Labs integration.

agents.name: LanguageAgent
agents.description: Language detection + in-language triage + reply parsing

agents.name: RTSLookupAgent
agents.description: Parallel AED + drug-interaction + ambulance ETA lookup

agents.name: SummaryAgent
agents.description: Template-driven English handoff + optional AI impression

agents.name: ComplianceAgent
agents.description: Audit trail + anonymized case memory + learning loop

low_code_agents.name: RoutingAgent
low_code_agents.description: Specialist selection by specialty + proximity + load
